_comment: Provenance for vendored skills. Kept outside the skill directories so those stay byte-identical to upstream. The room panel links each skill chip to its `url`.

ui-ux-pro-max.note: Kept vendored but NOT granted, so the variant-A build stays reproducible. Re-add it to rooms/factory.yaml skills: to switch back.

design-taste-frontend.note: Anti-slop frontend skill. V2 is upstream's own default and is flagged experimental; a v1 is published alongside it. Trying V2 on the sandbox lead is exactly what the sandbox is for.

high-end-visual-design.note: Fonts, spacing, shadows and card structure; blocks the defaults that make generated pages look cheap.

impeccable.note: Design-quality checks and a polish pass. Ships hooks and slash commands for interactive Claude Code; agent runs here set strict_mcp_config with setting_sources=[], so only the SKILL.md half is expected to apply.

emil-design-eng.note: Emil Kowalski's UI-polish philosophy. The primary skill only — its siblings are animation, React Native and Swift skills that do not apply to a static page.
